findings.title: Clamp's doc comment has a typo
findings.detail: The comment reads "Clamp restrict v" where it should read "restricts".
findings.risk_rationale: Cosmetic, but a doc comment should read correctly.

findings.title: unusedHelper is dead code
findings.detail: unusedHelper is defined but never called anywhere in this package.
findings.risk_rationale: Dead code adds no risk on its own but should not ship.

findings.title: Average has no doc comment
findings.detail: Average is exported but undocumented, unlike Clamp.
findings.risk_rationale: Every other exported function in this package is documented.
